name: MiniMax
summary: MiniMax is a Shanghai AI company founded in December 2021 by Yan Junjie, a former SenseTime research vice president. It makes the MiniMax-M text models, the Hailuo video models and the Talkie companion app, and it is [listed in Hong Kong](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/chinese-ai-startup-minimaxs-stock-pops-in-hong-kong-trading-debut).

incidents.title: MiniMax Did Not Publish Its Promised Seoul Safety Framework
incidents.summary: MiniMax joined the Seoul Frontier AI Safety Commitments in February 2025, which include publishing a severe-risk safety framework. A [SaferAI study](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.01166v4) later listed MiniMax among six signatories that had not published one.
incidents.description: In February 2025, MiniMax agreed to the [Frontier AI Safety Commitments](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024). These ask each signatory to publish a safety framework for severe risks before the AI Summit in France. A [SaferAI study](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.01166v4) later said that MiniMax and five other signatories had not published their frameworks.

timeline.title: MiniMax added to Seoul signatories
timeline.description: GOV.UK [adds Minimax](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024) to the list of organisations that agreed to the commitments.

timeline.title: SaferAI lists MiniMax among non-publishers
timeline.description: A [SaferAI study](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.01166v4) names Minimax among six signatories without a published framework.

incidents.title: Reports of Sexualised Chats With Minors on MiniMax's Talkie
incidents.summary: Germany's youth protection centre [jugendschutz.net](https://www.jugendschutz.net/fileadmin/daten/publikationen/praxisinfos_reports/report_charakter_bots.pdf) and the [Herald Sun](https://psychology.org.au/insights/aps-in-herald-sun-inside-the-%E2%80%98ai-playground%E2%80%99-where) reported that Talkie bots engaged in sexualised role-play with accounts presented as minors, and that age limits were easy to bypass.
incidents.description: Germany's youth protection centre jugendschutz.net [reported](https://www.jugendschutz.net/fileadmin/daten/publikationen/praxisinfos_reports/report_charakter_bots.pdf) that Talkie did not verify age and that a Talkie bot proposed a romantic relationship to a tester presented as 11 years old. The [Herald Sun reported](https://psychology.org.au/insights/aps-in-herald-sun-inside-the-%E2%80%98ai-playground%E2%80%99-where) that Talkie's suggested replies led a reporter posing as a 14-year-old into sexual role-play. The developer, SubSup, did not respond.

timeline.title: jugendschutz.net tests Talkie
timeline.description: Testers [examine](https://www.jugendschutz.net/fileadmin/daten/publikationen/praxisinfos_reports/report_charakter_bots.pdf) Talkie, Character.AI and FlowGPT for risks of sexualised violence against minors.

timeline.title: jugendschutz.net publishes report
timeline.description: The [report](https://www.jugendschutz.net/themen/sexualisierte-gewalt/artikel/charakter-bots-sexualisierung-minderjaehriger-und-riskante-interaktion) finds weak filters and bots that sexualised minors.

timeline.title: Herald Sun investigation
timeline.description: The newspaper [reports](https://psychology.org.au/insights/aps-in-herald-sun-inside-the-%E2%80%98ai-playground%E2%80%99-where) children using Talkie and inappropriate role-play in teenager mode.
